name: Niacinamide
description: Niacinamide (Vitamin B3) is a water-soluble vitamin that works to improve uneven skin tone, reduce pore appearance, strengthen the skin barrier, and regulate oil production. It is well-tolerated by most skin types and is one of the most versatile skincare ingredients available.

name: Glycerin
description: Glycerin is a powerful humectant that draws water from the environment into the skin. It is one of the most common and effective moisturizing ingredients in skincare, helping to maintain the skin barrier and keep skin hydrated and plump.

name: Hyaluronic Acid
description: Hyaluronic acid is a naturally occurring substance in the skin that can hold up to 1000x its weight in water. In skincare it provides intense hydration, plumps the skin, and reduces the appearance of fine lines.

name: Butylene Glycol
description: Butylene glycol is a lightweight humectant and solvent commonly used in skincare. It helps products spread easily, enhances penetration of other ingredients, and provides mild moisturizing benefits.

name: Pentylene Glycol
description: Pentylene glycol is a multifunctional ingredient that acts as a moisturizer, solvent, and mild preservative. It provides hydration and has some antimicrobial properties.

name: Dipropylene Glycol
description: Dipropylene glycol is used in skincare as a solvent and humectant. It helps with product texture and provides mild moisturizing benefits.

name: 1 2-Hexanediol
description: 1,2-Hexanediol is a multifunctional cosmetic ingredient used as a humectant, solvent, and preservative booster. It provides mild moisturizing effects and helps stabilize formulations.

name: Betaine
description: Betaine is a naturally derived humectant from sugar beets. It helps retain moisture in the skin, reduces irritation, and supports the skin barrier function. It is very well tolerated even by sensitive skin.

name: Glucose
description: Glucose is a simple sugar used in skincare as a humectant and skin-conditioning agent. It helps attract moisture to the skin surface.

name: Fructose
description: Fructose is a natural sugar used as a humectant in skincare. It helps maintain skin hydration and is part of the skin's natural moisturizing factors.

name: Tromethamine
description: Tromethamine is used in skincare primarily as a pH adjuster and buffering agent. It helps maintain the optimal pH of skincare formulations for ingredient efficacy and skin compatibility.

name: Ethylhexylglycerin
description: Ethylhexylglycerin is a multifunctional ingredient used as a skin-conditioning agent and preservative booster. It has mild deodorant properties and helps improve the skin feel of formulations.

name: Glutathione
description: Glutathione is a powerful antioxidant naturally produced by the body. In skincare it helps brighten the complexion, reduce hyperpigmentation, and protect against oxidative damage.

name: Hydroxypropyl Methylcellulose
description: Hydroxypropyl methylcellulose is a cellulose-derived polymer used in skincare as a thickener, film-former, and stabilizer. It helps create a smooth texture and can form a protective film on the skin.

name: Carbomer
description: Carbomer is a synthetic polymer used in skincare as a thickening and stabilizing agent. It helps create gel-like textures in formulations and is generally well-tolerated.

name: Disodium EDTA
description: Disodium EDTA is a chelating agent used in skincare to bind metal ions that could destabilize formulations. It helps maintain product stability and efficacy.

name: Chitosan
description: Chitosan is a biopolymer derived from chitin found in crustacean shells. In skincare it provides film-forming, moisturizing, and antimicrobial benefits. It can help support the skin barrier and retain moisture.

name: Polyacrylate Crosspolymer-6
description: Polyacrylate crosspolymer-6 is a synthetic polymer used as a thickener and texture enhancer in skincare formulations. It helps create smooth and stable product textures.

name: Acrylates/C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate Crosspolymer
description: A synthetic cross-linked acrylic acid polymer used as an emulsion stabilizer and thickener in skincare products. Helps create stable and elegant product textures.

name: Iron Oxides
description: Iron oxides are mineral pigments used in cosmetics and skincare for coloring. They are generally considered safe and non-irritating for all skin types.

name: Water
description: Water (Aqua) is the most common ingredient in skincare products, serving as a solvent and vehicle for other active ingredients. It helps hydrate the skin and ensures proper product texture.

name: Zea Mays (Corn) Starch
description: Corn starch is used in skincare as an absorbent and skin-conditioning agent. It helps mattify the skin and improve product texture.
